description: Clean-context public-web cases for building a provisional AI visibility prompt panel from only a URL and description.

cases.description: Rippling is a modular workforce platform spanning HR, payroll, IT, and spend.
Cloudflare is a network platform spanning CDN and performance, application security, Zero Trust and SASE, DNS, and edge compute.
Wise is a cross-border personal and business money service with an embedded platform.
Zocdoc is a US patient and provider healthcare-booking marketplace organized around insurance, location, and availability.
Taskrabbit is a local marketplace connecting clients and Taskers for assembly, moving, repair, errands, and related services.
Airalo is a travel eSIM marketplace with local, regional, and global packages constrained by destination, device, and plan.
Oura is a smart ring and membership for wellness, sleep, activity, and recovery tracking.
TurboTax is a US tax-preparation service with DIY, assisted, and full-service options whose eligibility and price vary by tax year, forms, state, and tax situation.
Octopus Energy UK is an energy supplier with standard and dynamic tariffs plus EV, solar, battery, heat-pump, export, metering, and payment offerings.
The redesigned 2026 Toyota RAV4 is a compact SUV with hybrid and plug-in-hybrid powertrains, multiple trims, local inventory and dealer offers, ownership support, and US/Canada differences.
